level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Subdue
level_four.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level_seven.title: Sins Exposed
level_seven.description: Punish reduces healing received by 35% for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them refresh this duration.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Holy Fury
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each Hero hit by Condemn increases this damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Holy Renewal
level_sixteen.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1 second and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.

level_twenty.title: Blinded By The Light
level_twenty.description: Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 25% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.  Hitting Heroes with Shield Glare reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 8 seconds.

level_one.title: Maximum Effort
level_one.description: If Carnage damages the same enemy Hero 3 times it deals an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

level_four.title: Upstage
level_four.description: Damaging at least 2 Heroes with Blood Rage causes Qhira to Evade the next 4 Heroic Basic Attacks within 12 seconds.

level_seven.title: The Thirst
level_seven.description: Carnage heals for 50% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. Anytime Carnage damages an enemy Hero, Qhira's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds against an enemy Hero deals 15% additional damage, stacking up to 10 times.

level_ten.title: Unrelenting Strikes
level_ten.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Chainsaw
level_thirteen.description: Carnage's cooldown recharges 100% faster while an enemy Hero has maximum Blood Rage stacks.

level_sixteen.title: Booming Kick
level_sixteen.description: Increase the Stun duration of Revolving Sweep's re-activation by 0.25 seconds. Enemy Heroes around the primary target are also affected by Revolving Sweep's re-activation.

level_twenty.title: Silent Killer
level_twenty.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Unrelenting Strikes Silences them for 0.5 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Colossal Totem
level_one.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

level_four.title: Earthliving Enchant
level_four.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Purification
level_seven.description: If Purge removes a Slow, Stun, Root, or Silence effect from an ally, heal them for 220 (+4% per level).  Using Purge on an enemy Hero deals up to 330 (+4% per level) damage to Shields and reduces healing received by 40% for 2 seconds.  Passive: Reduce Purge's cooldown by 15 seconds.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Tidal Waves
level_thirteen.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

level_sixteen.title: Earthgrasp Totem
level_sixteen.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Farseer's Blessing
level_twenty.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

level_one.title: Sentinel Wisp
level_one.description: After remaining in a bush for 5 seconds, Wisp's vision radius is increased by 200% and reveals the surrounding area.

level_four.title: Nature's Culling
level_four.description: Increases Nature's Toxin's damage by 125% to non-Heroes.

level_seven.title: Splintered Spear
level_seven.description: Casting Noxious Blossom grants Lunara 3 stacks of Splintered Spear. When Lunara uses her Basic Attack, it hits an additional enemy for each stack of Splintered Spear, consuming 1 stack for each target. Stores up to 3 stacks.  Splintered Spear deals 90 (+4% per level) damage, and applies Nature's Toxin.

level_ten.title: Thornwood Vine
level_ten.description: Send forth vines that deal 184 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line.  Stores up to 3 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Abolish Magic
level_thirteen.description: Target an ally to remove all damage over time and disabling effects from them and Lunara. For 2 seconds after, the duration of disabling effects is reduced by 50%.

level_sixteen.title: Unfair Advantage
level_sixteen.description: Nature's Toxin deals 60% more damage to Heroes that are Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

level_twenty.title: Intensifying Toxin
level_twenty.description: At 3 stacks, Nature's Toxin deals 40% more damage.

level_one.title: Amateur Opponent
level_one.description: Twin Blades attacks deal 150% bonus damage to non-Heroes.

level_four.title: Shield Battery
level_four.description: Shield Overload's cooldown recharges 125% faster while its Shield is active.  Passive: Reduce Shield Overload's cooldown by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Final Cut
level_seven.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage. While under 25% Health, this damage bonus is increased to 60%.

level_ten.title: Suppression Pulse
level_ten.description: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.

level_thirteen.title: Triple Strike
level_thirteen.description: Increases Twin Blades's number of Basic Attacks to 3, but increase its cooldown by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Titan Killer
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 0.5% of the target's maximum Health in damage, increased to 1.5% when empowered by Twin Blades.

level_twenty.title: Plasma Burn
level_twenty.description: While Shield Overload is active, deal 70 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

level_one.title: Increasing Clarity
level_one.description: Quest: Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.

level_four.title: Majestic Span
level_four.description: Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.

level_seven.title: Energized Cord
level_seven.description: Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 130% of the damage against Heroes and 70% of the damage against non-Heroes.  Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.  Passive: Increase Basic Attack Range by 1.1.

level_ten.title: Crystal Aegis
level_ten.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

level_thirteen.title: Converging Force
level_thirteen.description: Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.

level_sixteen.title: Wrath of Heaven
level_sixteen.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 15% Spell Power.  Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Overpower
level_one.description: When Parry blocks a Hero's Basic Attack, Heroic Strike's cooldown is refreshed and the next one does 40% more damage.

level_four.title: Taunt
level_four.description: Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.  Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

level_seven.title: Second Wind
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.

level_ten.title: Shield Wall
level_ten.description: Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

level_thirteen.title: Shattering Throw
level_thirteen.description: Activate to throw a sword at a target Hero that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage, and up to 1400 (+4% per level) bonus damage to their Shields.  Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal up to 200% bonus Physical Damage to Shields.

level_sixteen.title: Banner of Dalaran
level_sixteen.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20% increased Spell Power to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

level_one.title: Puncturing Arrow
level_one.description: Increase the number of Hungering Arrow bounces by 1.  Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Hungering Arrow refunds 40 Mana and permanently increases the damage of its initial impact by 6.

level_four.title: Repeating Arrow
level_four.description: Vault no longer has a Mana cost. Casting Vault resets the cooldown of Hungering Arrow.

level_seven.title: Monster Hunter
level_seven.description: Hungering Arrow deals 150% additional damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_ten.title: Strafe
level_ten.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 70 (+4% per level) damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Siphoning Arrows
level_thirteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Hungering Arrow heals Valla for 4% of her maximum Health, and Multishot heals for 2%.

level_sixteen.title: Manticore
level_sixteen.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 4% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_one.title: Gathering Storm
level_one.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Hammerang. Restore 6 Mana for each Hero hit. Upon dying, Lose 8 stacks.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals 30% more damage.  Reward: After hitting 80 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 50% damage.  Mythic Reward: After hitting 150 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 70% damage.

level_four.title: Updraft
level_four.description: Increases Barrel Roll's range by 40% and Shield amount by 70%, and its Shield now lasts indefinitely.

level_seven.title: BOOMerang
level_seven.description: Hammerang's explosion deals 100% additional damage, and hitting enemy Heroes reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Hinterland Blast
level_ten.description: After 1 second, deal 475 (+4.75% per level) damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.

level_thirteen.title: Flow Rider
level_thirteen.description: While Tailwind is active, Falstad's Basic Abilities recharge 100% faster.

level_sixteen.title: Crippling Hammer
level_sixteen.description: Increase Hammerang's Slow from 25% to 50%, and Hammerang's explosion also Slows.

level_one.title: Borean Winds
level_one.description: After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed.  Passive: Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.

level_four.title: Icy Talons
level_four.description: Gain 3% Attack Speed for 2 seconds every time a Hero is damaged by Frozen Tempest, up to a maximum of 60%.

level_seven.title: Rune Tap
level_seven.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack heals Arthas for 5% of his max Health.  Passive: Each stack of Frostmourne Hungers increases Arthas's maximum Health by 10.

level_ten.title: Summon Sindragosa
level_ten.description: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Biting Cold
level_thirteen.description: Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 15% bonus damage, up to a 75% bonus.

level_sixteen.title: Frostmourne Feeds
level_sixteen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers by 6 seconds. Arthas heals for 75% of the Basic Attack damage dealt by Frostmourne Hungers.
